name: MethaneOgmpInventoryReporter
tagline: OGMP 2.0 methane inventory, reporting levels, site-level reconciliation and targets – one plug-and-play app.
description: A complete methane inventory app for oil and gas in a single PCF control: emissions dashboard, source inventory with quantification and review workflow, OGMP 2.0 level matrix with Gold Standard progress, reconciliation of source-level and site-level measurements, reduction pathway and methane intensity. Works instantly with demo data and connects to collections, Dataverse, SharePoint or the Power Pages Web API.
features: OGMP 2.0 levels L1–L5 per source line with level/method checks
Equity or gross reporting basis, CO2e with configurable GWP
Draft → Estimated → Measured → In review → Approved → Reported workflow with Rework
Site-level vs source-level reconciliation with tolerance and adjustment lines
Gold Standard progress and upgrade plan
Linear reduction pathway and methane intensity vs target
Bulk status, level and owner actions, CSV export, undo
controlType: standard (data-set) + standard field control MethaneOgmpInventoryReporterPortal for Power Pages
